story.title: Global cybersecurity gap widens as AI-powered attacks surge and defensive tools remain unevenly distributed
story.summary: Rest of World reports that restricted access to powerful AI-based defensive security tools — including Anthropic's Mythos platform — is leaving companies, central banks, and governments in lower-income countries significantly more exposed to AI-powered cyberattacks. As offensive AI capabilities spread faster than defensive ones, a structural cybersecurity inequality is emerging between nations. Experts warn this gap could destabilise financial systems and critical infrastructure in vulnerable economies.
